|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-L-theforceisstrongwiththisone-2022-12-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-L-theforceisstrongwiththisone-2020-05-12.gif]], 12 May 2020) → [[File:V3-L-theforceisstrongwiththisone-2022-12-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-L-theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif]], 1 December 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[The Force Is Strong With This One (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-theforceisstrongwith022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “The Force Is Strong With This One”. Text: “If your padawan or Skywalker of ability < 6 is in battle with a Dark Jedi, either add one battle destiny or cancel I Have You Now.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Force Is Strong With This One (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-theforceisstrongwitha5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “If your padawan or Skywalker” → “If your Padawan or Skywalker”; “or Skywalker of ability < 6 is in” → “or Skywalker is in”; “You Now.” → “You Now. OR If Luke is in battle with an opponent's character of ability > 3, add one battle destiny.”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “The Force Is Strong With This One”. Text: “If your Padawan or Skywalker is in battle with a Dark Jedi, either add one battle destiny or cancel I Have You Now. OR If Luke is in battle with an opponent's character of ability > 3, add one battle destiny.”
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 1 December 2022<ref name="img-theforceisstrongwitheb53af7">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 commit eb53af7] (1 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). OR If Luke is in battle with an opponent's character of ability > 3, add one battle destiny.”
